plans.idea: Faithful centered story stack: logo crowns the top, a large centered bottle fills the upper half, then the 30% OFF headline block, a wide centered CTA pill and the legal text closing the bottom, all on one center axis.

Offer-first: under a small logo the 30% OFF headline block leads the top third so the discount is read first, then the bottle as proof, then the CTA directly below the product, with legal text at the foot.

Product-poster with a brand sign-off: an oversized bottle takes the full top half, the headline block and CTA sit in the middle band, and the logo moves down as a centered sign-off just above the legal line.
